title: The Big OC Pack [Koikatu! / Koikatsu! (コイカツ！)]
description:
## What is this?

I’ve archived most of the OC Koikatu cards that were ever released. 
You will not find characters from your favorite anime here. They are in the [CCCCP.](https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/3330941) 
This is for everything else - that is: the original content.

==================================================================

## How big are we talking?


260 GB uncompressed.
Please see 'Tree' files for a preview.

This archive has had minimal pruning for duplicates, because it was never meant to see the light of day.
It is surfacing now because I'm retiring in my capacity as the archivist.

==================================================================

## Contents:
!.7z  ==> Everything besides character cards
#.7z  ==> Tier 1 sources (arbitrary designation)
OC&？OC.7z ==> Tier 2 sources (again, an arbitrary designation, I don't mean to offend users of any site)
officialup.7z ==> Stuff from the official uploader, including stuff that may have been deleted
z_Misc.7z ==> Miscellaneous card packs
Tree (folders) ==> Treemap of folders, allows you to see folders
Tree (files) ==> Treemap of files, allows you to see filenames



==================================================================

### IMPORTANT:
Some files and folders in this archive have very long path names.
Windows does not like path names longer than 260 characters.
This is the reason why the zip files are kept short.

I keep this folder at the root of C:\ drive.
You can do the same, or extract only the folders you want.

==================================================================

### Release Notes:

And so the promised time has come. I'm sorry if it's too little or too late.
I regret only that I had nothing more witty to say.

⠀
⠀
....

⠀
Just know that I cared for all the lost cards out there.
⠀
⠀
⠀
⠀  ⠀⠀⠀⠀  *~murph_was_buried_in_'93*
⠀

==================================================================
